from config_reader import read_settings

class TestReadSettings(unittest.TestCase):
    
    def test_basic_functionality(self):
        text = """endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:8080
enabled = true"""
        result = read_settings(text)
        self.assertEqual(result['endpoint'], 'http://127.0.0.1:8080')
        self.assertEqual(result['enabled'], True)
    
    def test_false_value(self):
        text = """endpoint = http://example.com
enabled = false"""
        result = read_settings(text)
        self.assertEqual(result['enabled'], False)
    
    def test_blank_lines_ignored(self):
        text = """# comment

endpoint = http://example.com

enabled = true"""
        result = read_settings(text)
        self.assertEqual(result['endpoint'], 'http://example.com')
        self.assertEqual(result['enabled'], True)
    
    def test_duplicate_key_raises(self):
        text = """endpoint = http://a.com
endpoint = http://b.com
enabled = true"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            read_settings(text)
        self.assertIn('Duplicate key', str(ctx.exception))
    
    def test_malformed_line_raises(self):
        text = """no equals sign here
enabled = true"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            read_settings(text)
        self.assertIn('Malformed', str(ctx.exception))
    
    def test_missing_endpoint_raises(self):
        text = """enabled = true"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            read_settings(text)
        self.assertIn('endpoint', str(ctx.exception))
    
    def test_missing_enabled_raises(self):
        text = """endpoint = http://example.com"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            read_settings(text)
        self.assertIn('enabled', str(ctx.exception))
    
    def test_whitespace_ignored(self):
        text = """  endpoint = http://example.com  
  enabled = true  """
        result = read_settings(text)
        self.assertEqual(result['endpoint'], 'http://example.com')
        self.assertEqual(result['enabled'], True)
    
    def test_boolean_parsing(self):
        text = """endpoint = http://example.com
enabled = TRUE"""
        result = read_settings(text)
        self.assertEqual(result['enabled'], True)
    
    def test_invalid_boolean_raises(self):
        text = """endpoint = http://example.com
enabled = yes"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            read_settings(text)
        self.assertIn('Invalid', str(ctx.exception))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
